Dialog.title: this.title
Dialog.p: The Odoo Mates WhatsApp Connector does not answer on this page, so the message is not sent yet.

ol.li: Installed? Click its icon in the toolbar of the browser (under the puzzle piece), then Allow this Odoo.
Not installed yet? Install the Odoo Mates WhatsApp Connector from the Chrome Web Store (Firefox add-on coming soon).

Dialog.p: Then click Send: the message goes with its files, without leaving Odoo.
Still no answer from the extension on this page: allow this Odoo in it, then click Send again.
